title: Saving with the part number unchanged leaves the number and open work alone
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-UNCHNUM-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL UNCHNUM Vendor) exists.
  • Open purchase order {Purchase-order-A} (for example PO-1001) for {Vendor-A} has a line for {Part-A}, picked from the lookup, with 2 ordered and none received.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Change only the Sell Price to 22.00.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click the clock icon (Part History) on the {Part-A} row.
  6. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
  7. Go to Parts → Purchase Orders and open {Purchase-order-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the change is saved and the window closes.
  • Step 5: no "Part number updated" entry was written.
  • Step 6: one entry, {Part-A}.
  • Step 7: the {Purchase-order-A} line still reads {Part-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
